The goal is to continuously deliver business value and support customers in achieving their operational goals. Denovos solutions are designed to manage and improve customers business operations, reduce risk, and provide zero delay with our proactive and strategic service. 
 Summary 
 We are seeking an experienced JD Edwards (JDE) CNC Managed Services Administrator to provide enterprise-level administration, optimization, and operational excellence for JD Edwards EnterpriseOne environments. This position is dedicated exclusively to managed services support and ongoing operation. The ideal candidate will bring deep technical expertise in CNC administration, automation, system resilience, and ITIL-driven service delivery. 
 Key Responsibilities Operational Excellence System Administration Own day-to-day operations of multiple JDE EnterpriseOne instances across Development, Test, Production, and Disaster Recovery environments. Perform advanced CNC administration tasks including multi-environment package management, object lifecycle management, and ESU/Tools Release maintenance. Optimize system performance (CPU, memory, kernel tuning, and cache management) and proactively mitigate performance bottlenecks. Administer and maintain JDE Security at an enterprise level (row/column security, SoD compliance, role-based access). Monitoring Automation Implement proactive system health monitoring (CNC logs, kernel processes, batch jobs, orchestrator queues). Leverage orchestration tools (JD Edwards Orchestrator, RPA, or other IT automation platforms) to streamline routine support tasks. High Availability, Compliance Disaster Recovery Maintain and test backup, recovery, failover, and disaster recovery strategies for JDE environments. Support high-availability architectures (load balancing, clustering, multi-server JAS/HTML instances). Ensure compliance with internal IT governance, audit requirements, and security policies. Prepare audit-ready documentation on CNC controls, change management, and access provisioning. Collaboration Managed Services Delivery Work closely with DBAs, infrastructure, security, and functional teams to sustain system availability and integrity. Follow ITIL-based service delivery processes (Incident, Change, Problem, Knowledge Management). Provide capacity planning, system usage analytics, and recommendations for proactive resource scaling. 
 
 
 
 Requirements 
 Required Qualifications Skills Bachelor s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related discipline (or equivalent experience). 7+ years of CNC Administration experience in a managed services/enterprise support model. Expert-level understanding of JD Edwards EnterpriseOne architecture (Deployment Server, Enterprise Server, JAS, AIS, BSSV, Orchestrator). Deep knowledge of JD Edwards administration on at least one major OS platform (Windows/Linux/IBM i/Unix). Strong database expertise (Oracle, SQL Server, or DB2) including CNC integration points. Proficiency with WebLogic, WebSphere, and other middleware components used in JDE. Skilled in scripting/automation (PowerShell, Shell scripting, Python, or Ansible). Strong understanding of system monitoring solutions (e.g., OEM, Dynatrace, Splunk, or ServiceNow Monitoring). Solid experience in IT security and compliance frameworks (SoD, SOX, GDPR). Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and performance optimization skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a customer-first, service-oriented mindset. The estimated base rate range for this position: $120,000.00 - $140,000.00 per year . The actual annual salary is based on fair market value based on your geographical location, skills, role requirements, and responsibilities. This posted compensation is a good faith and reasonable estimate. Denovo reserves the right to adjust this range depending on the selected candidates qualifications. 
 Denovo provides a comprehensive benefits package that includes, but is not limited to Medical, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability insurance, FSA (Health Dependent Care), HSA, 401(k), PTO, Paid Holidays, as well as Supplemental Benefits for Accident, Critical Illness, Identity Theft, and Legal support.

Our culture is the ideal blend of entrepreneurial spirit and enterprise investment, enabling the chance to move at a rapid pace with some of the most complex, leading-edge technologies available. 
 For over 35 years, the experts at Mitratech have been focused on solving the complex needs. Today, we serve 20,000 client companies of all sizes globally, representing 30% of the Fortune 500 and over 500,000 users in over 160 countries. 
 As we continue to grow, were always looking for resourceful, enthusiastic, and fresh perspectives. Join our global team and see what makes Mitratech a truly exceptional place to work! 
 About the Role We're looking for a Senior Data Analytics Engineer to own and operate our Snowflake data platform. This role supports the data pipelines that feed Snowflake, which in turn power data and reporting presented directly to our customers within our products. The role is primarily focused on Snowflake platform administration and data engineering account management, performance/cost optimization, data pipelines (dbt, Fivetran), and the overall health of the platform with security, access governance, and cloud/DevOps responsibilities as a supporting part of the job. You'll work closely with platform and product engineering teams and cloud operations to ensure the pipelines and Snowflake environment behind our customer-facing product data are scalable, performant, and reliable. 
 What You'll Do Snowflake Platform & Data Engineering (primary focus) Administer and maintain multiple Snowflake accounts, including account-level configuration, org structure, and cross-account governance Own Snowflake performance and cost: warehouse sizing, resource monitors, query tuning, and storage optimization Manage Snowflake platform changes via infrastructure-as-code where applicable (e.g., Terraform, Snowflake CLI/SQL scripts) and change management processes Support and maintain Fivetran connectors for data ingestion from SaaS applications, databases, and APIs Support and lightly maintain dbt models (staging, intermediate, mart layers) that feed data into product-facing Snowflake datasets Troubleshoot pipeline and transformation issues, including those that intersect with platform-level access or performance, to protect the reliability of data presented to customers Integrate Snowflake and pipeline health (job failures, data freshness, query performance) into the team's observability stack for centralized monitoring and alerting Contribute to runbooks and postmortems for platform and pipeline incidents 
 Security, Access & Cloud/DevOps (supporting focus) Own Snowflake security: role-based access control (RBAC) design, object/data-level permissions, network policies, and data masking Manage user access lifecycle provisioning, de-provisioning, role assignment, and periodic access reviews Configure and maintain SSO integration for Snowflake authentication via Microsoft Entra ID , working with the identity/security team as needed Apply general cloud SRE/DevOps practices to the data platform — mainly AWS , with some exposure to Azure and OCI — covering IAM, networking/connectivity, monitoring integration, and infrastructure-as-code Own access certification and periodic access review cycles for Snowflake, producing evidence for ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II audits where the underlying product requires it Maintain audit logging retention and usage/query history analysis to support security investigations and compliance requirements Partner with the compliance/security team on control evidence, remediation tracking, and audit responses specific to the data platform 
 What You'll Bring 8+ years of experience in data engineering or data platform administration, with hands-on production experience running Snowflake (account management, performance tuning, cost management) Working knowledge of dbt and Fivetran (or comparable ELT tools) for building and troubleshooting data pipelines Strong SQL skills and solid understanding of data warehousing concepts Working knowledge of Git-based version control and infrastructure-as-code practices Comfort integrating platform/pipeline monitoring into a centralized observability tool General cloud SRE/DevOps experience, mainly AWS with some exposure to Azure and OCI , applied to a data platform (IAM, networking, monitoring, automation) Practical experience with user access management and SSO configuration for a SaaS/cloud platform (Entra ID/Azure AD experience a plus) Familiarity with audit/compliance processes (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2) — access reviews, evidence gathering, control documentation Good communication skills — comfortable working with product/platform engineering and security stakeholders 
 Nice to Have Experience with Amazon QuickSight or similar BI/visualization tools Experience with Terraform or other IaC tools for managing cloud/data platform resources Experience with Python or equivalent for automation/scripting Experience working in a multi-cloud environment (AWS primary, with Azure and/or OCI) SnowPro Core or Administrator certification Background or experience with GRC, compliance, or security-conscious SaaS environments

title: Academic Coordinator
description:
Job Opening: Academic Coordinator 
 Company: Radiant Minds Education Ltd
 Job Title: Academic Coordinator
 Location: Work From Home (Remote India)
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Salary: 50,000 - 60,000 per month (67.2 LPA)
 Working Days: Monday to Saturday (6 days per week)
 Working Hours: 9-hour shift aligned with UK business hours
 Reporting To: Company Directors / Senior Management 
 About Radiant Minds Education Ltd Radiant Minds Education Ltd is a UK-based education and vocational training provider delivering regulated qualifications in areas including Early Years Education, Functional Skills and professional development. We work with recognised UK awarding organisations and are committed to maintaining high standards of teaching, assessment, internal quality assurance, learner support and regulatory compliance. 
 About the Role 
 We are seeking a highly educated, academically accomplished, exceptionally organised and self-motivated Academic Coordinator to oversee academic operations, coordinate learner assessments, provide academic support, undertake academic research and writing, and ensure the smooth delivery of our educational programmes. 
 This is a multifaceted position requiring an individual who can confidently manage academic responsibilities, coordinate with tutors and assessors, maintain accurate educational records and support senior management in achieving academic and organisational objectives. 
 The successful candidate must possess an outstanding academic background, exceptional English writing and communication skills, strong research capabilities and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision . 
 We are particularly interested in candidates who demonstrate intellectual ability, academic excellence, meticulous attention to detail and a proactive approach to managing responsibilities. 
 Key Roles and Responsibilities 
 1. Academic Coordination Oversee and coordinate the day-to-day academic operations of the organisation. Manage learner enrolment records, academic schedules, assessment deadlines and qualification completion timelines. Monitor learners' academic progress, assignment submissions, outstanding assessments and portfolio completion. Coordinate with tutors, assessors, Internal Quality Assurers (IQAs), learners and management. Maintain accurate learner progress trackers, academic records and assessment documentation. Conduct regular follow-ups with learners to ensure timely completion of academic requirements. Organise online academic support sessions, learner reviews and meetings. Ensure academic activities align with the requirements of UK awarding organisations. 
 2. Academic Writing, Research and Assignment Support 
 Exceptional academic writing and research skills are essential for this position. 
 Prepare high-quality, research-based academic content, model assignments, learning materials, reports and educational resources. Demonstrate strong capabilities in academic analysis, critical evaluation, reflective writing and evidence-based discussion. Conduct independent research using credible academic journals, government publications, educational frameworks and professional guidance. Apply accurate Harvard referencing, in-text citations and reference lists with relevant source URLs . Review, proofread, edit and format academic assignments to ensure clarity, accuracy, relevance and appropriate academic standards. Interpret assignment briefs, learning outcomes and assessment criteria to develop structured guidance and supporting resources. Prepare academic presentations, assessment guidance, teaching materials and professional educational documents. Ensure all academic content is original, appropriately referenced and written in professional British English. Maintain academic integrity and ensure that learner submissions represent the learners' own work. Complete academic writing, research and documentation tasks within strict deadlines. 
 3. Assessment and Quality Assurance Coordination 
 Coordinate assignment submissions, assessment reviews, resubmissions and portfolio completion. Liaise with assessors and IQAs to ensure assessment activities are completed within agreed timelines. Maintain assessment trackers and monitor outstanding evidence, assessment decisions and learner progress. Support the preparation of assessment plans, learner feedback documentation and progress reports. Assist in organising documentation for Internal Quality Assurance (IQA) and External Quality Assurance (EQA) reviews. Maintain accurate records in accordance with UK qualification and awarding organisation requirements. Identify assessment delays, documentation discrepancies and outstanding academic requirements. Support the implementation of quality improvement actions and academic procedures. 
 4. Academic Documentation and Record Management 
 Prepare, format and maintain academic documents, assessment plans, learner progress reports, spreadsheets and presentations. Maintain organised electronic filing systems, learner databases and academic records. Prepare and update academic trackers, assessment schedules and qualification completion reports. Ensure learner records, assessment documentation and academic evidence are accurately maintained. Monitor academic deadlines, outstanding submissions and pending learner requirements. Maintain confidentiality and comply with organisational data protection policies. Ensure all academic documents are professionally formatted, appropriately stored and accessible to authorised personnel. 
 5. Academic Communication 
 Communicate assignment deadlines, assessment requirements and academic updates to learners. Provide clear explanations of assessment criteria, qualification structures and academic expectations. Liaise with UK-based tutors, assessors, awarding organisations and other educational stakeholders. Monitor outstanding academic queries and ensure timely responses. Escalate significant academic concerns or learner progress issues to senior management. 
 6. Academic Planning and Management Support 
 Assist senior management in planning and coordinating academic activities. Prepare academic schedules, progress reports and assessment completion summaries. Monitor departmental academic targets and qualification completion timelines. Coordinate assigned academic tasks and follow up with relevant staff. Prepare meeting agendas, minutes and action plans for academic review meetings. Provide regular updates on learner progress, outstanding assessments and academic performance. Support the development and implementation of academic policies and procedures. 
 7. Compliance, Quality Standards and Reporting 
 Support compliance with UK awarding organisation requirements and relevant educational standards. Maintain accurate academic documentation for internal reviews and external quality assurance visits. Assist with preparation for audits, inspections and awarding organisation reviews. Monitor academic quality, assessment deadlines and documentation requirements. Prepare daily and weekly academic progress reports for management. Identify gaps in academic records, learner evidence and assessment documentation. Support continuous improvement in academic delivery, assessment practices and learner outcomes. 
 Essential Academic Qualifications 
 A consistently strong academic background is a mandatory requirement for this position. 
 A Bachelor's degree from a recognised university is essential. A Master's degree is strongly preferred , particularly in English, Education, Early Childhood Education, Psychology, Sociology or a related academic discipline. Candidates with an M.Phil., PhD or other advanced academic qualifications will be given additional preference. Applicants should demonstrate consistently strong academic performance throughout their education. Candidates educated at reputed universities or recognised academic institutions with excellent academic records will be preferred. Exceptional English language proficiency, analytical thinking and academic comprehension skills are essential. Strong research, critical evaluation, report writing and professional documentation skills are mandatory. 
 Important: Academic qualifications alone will not be sufficient. Candidates must demonstrate the practical ability to produce high-quality academic work, coordinate educational activities and communicate professionally. 
 Essential Skills and Competencies Academic and Writing Skills Exceptional written and spoken English, with strong command of British English. Advanced academic writing, proofreading, editing and research capabilities. Ability to interpret complex academic instructions, learning outcomes and assessment criteria. Excellent critical thinking, analytical reasoning and problem-solving skills. Ability to independently prepare professional academic documents and educational resources. 
 Organisational and Technical Skills Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint. Good working knowledge of Google Workspace and cloud-based document management. Confidence in using Microsoft Teams, Zoom and online collaboration platforms. Experience maintaining academic trackers, spreadsheets, reports and electronic databases. Excellent organisational, multitasking and time-management skills. High attention to detail, accuracy and consistency in documentation. 
 Professional and Personal Attributes Highly self-motivated, dependable and accountable. Capable of working independently with minimal supervision. Proactive in identifying problems and implementing solutions. Excellent professional communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to manage multiple academic responsibilities and meet strict deadlines. Strong sense of confidentiality, integrity and professionalism. Willingness to take ownership of academic tasks and accept responsibility for outcomes. Adaptability and flexibility when working with UK-based teams and academic requirements. 
 Experience Requirements Candidates should ideally have relevant professional experience in one or more of the following areas: 
 Academic coordination or educational administration. Academic content development, research, assignment support or educational writing. Curriculum development, teaching or educational resource preparation. Academic quality assurance, assessment documentation or compliance support. Remote academic coordination for UK-based or international educational organisations. 
 Previous experience in the UK education or vocational training sector will be a significant advantage. Familiarity with the Early Years Foundation Stage (EYFS), UK-regulated qualifications, awarding organisations and assessment processes will be highly desirable. 
 Working Arrangements Work Mode: 100% Remote / Work From Home. Working Days: Monday to Saturday. Shift Duration: 9 hours per day, aligned with UK business hours. Candidates must be comfortable adjusting their working schedule according to UK daylight saving time. Regular communication will take place through email, Microsoft Teams, Zoom and other online platforms. Daily academic task updates and periodic progress reports must be provided to management. Candidates must have a personal laptop/computer, reliable high-speed internet connection and a suitable private working environment. Professionalism, punctuality, confidentiality and availability during working hours are essential. 
 Ideal Candidate Profile 
 We are looking for an intellectually capable, academically strong, highly articulate and exceptionally organised professional who can combine academic expertise with effective educational coordination. 
 The ideal candidate will have an excellent educational record, advanced English writing skills, strong research abilities and the confidence to manage complex academic responsibilities independently. 
 They should be equally comfortable preparing research-based academic materials, coordinating learner assessments, communicating with tutors and assessors, maintaining academic records and supporting senior management with academic planning. 
 We are seeking a high-calibre academic professional who demonstrates academic excellence, independent judgement, strong accountability and a genuine commitment to educational quality. 
 Please note: This is a full-time, six-day working position requiring a nine-hour shift aligned with UK business hours. Applicants must be comfortable managing academic responsibilities independently from home.

Key Skills: Curriculum development,Coordination,Education,Academics,Development

title: SQL DBA  SailPoint
description:
SQL DBA SailPoint 
 Mode : Remote Shift: rotation shift 4PM IST to 1AM IST and 12:00AM IST to 9:00AM IST. Notice : Immediate to 25 days 
 Job Summary 
We are seeking an experienced SQL Database Administrator (DBA) with 5 to 8+ years of hands-on experience, strong expertise in Microsoft SQL Server and SailPoint IdentityIQ to manage, optimize, secure, and support databases underlying enterprise Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) platforms. The role will be responsible for database infrastructure, performance tuning, high availability, disaster recovery, security, capacity management, automation, and operational support for SailPoint environments.
The ideal candidate will work closely with SailPoint application, infrastructure, security, and development teams to ensure database reliability, scalability, performance, and compliance across on-premises and cloud environments.
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. SailPoint Database Administration & Infrastructure 
 Install, configure, administer, and maintain Microsoft SQL Server instances supporting SailPoint IdentityIQ databases and related IGA workloads across on-premises and cloud environments. Manage SailPoint database schemas, configuration, migrations, and database changes required for platform upgrades and releases. Ensure SQL Server and database configurations are optimized for SailPoint workloads and enterprise standards. Support database connectivity between SailPoint application servers and backend SQL Server environments. 2. SailPoint Performance Tuning & Troubleshooting 
 Monitor and optimize SQL Server performance during high-volume SailPoint operations, including Identity Refresh, account/target aggregation, provisioning, certifications, entitlement processing, role processing, reporting, and workflow execution. Analyze and resolve blocking, deadlocks, lock contention, long-running transactions, connection-pool issues, CPU/IO bottlenecks, and transaction timeouts. Optimize complex T-SQL queries generated by SailPoint tasks, reporting processes, and custom integrations. Develop and maintain effective indexing and statistics strategies for high-volume SailPoint tables. Establish performance baselines for critical SailPoint tasks and identify performance degradation following application, configuration, or infrastructure changes. Perform root-cause analysis for SailPoint database-related failures, including transaction, session, locking, and timeout issues. Collaborate with SailPoint L3/application teams to determine whether performance issues originate from SQL Server, SailPoint configuration, application servers, custom code, or task concurrency. 3. High Availability & Disaster Recovery 
 Configure and administer SQL Server high-availability solutions, including Always On Availability Groups and Failover Cluster Instances (FCI), as required. Implement and maintain backup and recovery strategies, including full, differential, and transaction log backups. Develop, automate, and test point-in-time recovery procedures. Conduct periodic database restore and disaster recovery exercises to validate recovery readiness and support compliance requirements. Maintain appropriate RPO/RTO objectives for business-critical SailPoint environments. 4. Database Security, Auditing & Compliance 
 Implement least-privilege access controls for SailPoint service accounts, database administrators, application teams, and reporting tools. Secure sensitive identity and access-related data using appropriate SQL Server encryption technologies, including TDE and encryption in transit. Review database permissions, access patterns, and privilege escalation activities. Maintain database auditing and logging to support SOX, HIPAA, GDPR, and other applicable compliance requirements. Partner with security and compliance teams during database security assessments and audits. 5. SailPoint Connector & Integration Support 
 Design, implement, and support SQL Server schemas, views, stored procedures, and database objects used by SailPoint JDBC/SQL connectors. Support database integrations used for identity aggregation, provisioning, and target-system connectivity. Assist SailPoint developers and application teams with query optimization, schema design, and database-related integration issues. Troubleshoot database connectivity, authentication, timeout, locking, and performance issues affecting SailPoint integrations. 6. Database Monitoring, Automation & Maintenance 
 Implement and maintain proactive monitoring for SQL Server health, performance, availability, and capacity. Configure alerts for critical conditions such as CPU and memory pressure, deadlocks, failed jobs, connection issues, storage constraints, and transaction-log growth. Develop PowerShell and T-SQL automation for health checks, maintenance, integrity validation, alerting, and operational tasks. Perform routine database maintenance, including index maintenance, statistics updates, integrity checks, and job monitoring. Apply SQL Server cumulative updates, security patches, and other maintenance releases in accordance with enterprise change-management processes. Maintain dashboards and reporting for key database health and performance metrics. 7. Capacity, Growth & Data Retention Management 
 Monitor growth of SailPoint tables containing audit events, workflow data, task results, identity information, provisioning transactions, account data, and other high-volume operational records. Identify abnormal database and table growth and recommend appropriate retention, archival, purge, and indexing strategies. Forecast requirements for database storage, transaction logs, TempDB, CPU, memory, and I/O based on identity population and SailPoint workload growth. Analyze database impact from operational backlogs, including workflow events and identity-processing activities. Conduct database capacity and performance impact assessments before major activities such as mass Identity Refreshes, full aggregations, bulk provisioning, migrations, and production cleanup. Proactively prevent performance degradation caused by excessive historical or audit data. 8. SailPoint Workload & Task Scheduling Coordination 
 Partner with SailPoint application teams to optimize scheduling of database-intensive tasks and prevent excessive concurrent workloads. Analyze database utilization during Identity Refresh, aggregation, certification generation, reporting, maintenance, provisioning, and background workflow activities. Recommend scheduling, concurrency, partitioning, batch-size, and task-server distribution changes when SailPoint workloads create excessive database CPU, I/O, locking, or transaction-log utilization. Provide database performance and capacity guidance for large-scale SailPoint operations and application changes. Required Qualifications 
 Strong experience administering Microsoft SQL Server in enterprise production environments. Hands-on experience supporting SailPoint IdentityIQ databases and SailPoint application workloads. Strong knowledge of T-SQL, SQL Server performance tuning, indexing, statistics, execution plans, locking, blocking, and deadlock analysis. Experience with SQL Server backup, recovery, high availability, and disaster recovery technologies. Experience with SQL Server security, permissions, encryption, auditing, and compliance controls. Experience supporting database integrations using JDBC/SQL and stored procedures. Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills in complex application/database environments. Experience with PowerShell and T-SQL scripting for database automation and administration. Knowledge of database monitoring, alerting, capacity planning, and performance management. Strong communication and collaboration skills with application, infrastructure, security, and development teams. Preferred Qualifications 
 SailPoint IdentityIQ administration or production support experience. Experience supporting large-scale Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) environments. Experience with SQL Server Always On Availability Groups and/or Failover Cluster Instances. Experience supporting SQL Server in cloud environments such as Azure or AWS. Familiarity with SailPoint task architecture, aggregation, Identity Refresh, provisioning, certification, workflow, and connector processing. Experience working in regulated environments with SOX, HIPAA, GDPR, or similar compliance requirements. Relevant Microsoft SQL Server and/or SailPoint certifications are a plus.

Key Skills: Database Administrator (DBA),Sailpoint,Microsoft SQL Server and SailPoint IdentityIQ,Infrastructure,Performance Tuning & Troubleshooting,Serv,Performance,SQL DBA
